---
description: "Use when designing or changing Engineerparts pages, UI components, cards or navigation."
applyTo: "app/**/*.tsx,components/**/*.tsx,app/**/*.css"
---
# Frontend design

- Preserve brand colors, typography, content and existing workflows; reuse Tailwind tokens and shared UI.
- Build mobile-first layouts with stable image dimensions and readable text. Avoid layout shifts.
- Use semantic headings, links and buttons, visible focus, useful labels and keyboard access.
- Use restrained, purposeful motion; avoid unnecessary delays, movement or visual noise.
- Test desktop and mobile, empty and populated data, and existing interactive controls.
